deploy-bot: [deploy] Starting staged enable for catalog model 'cerberus-2.0' -> prod us-west-2 at 10% traffic. Rollout ID rwd-roll-1940. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/cerberus-2.0 (short).
maya: quick Q — what's the explicit fallback ordering for this rollout? we need to ensure quantized variant doesn't become the default under light load.
juan: agree. also: are we doing KV cache warmup for the canary? some workloads saw cold-cache latency spikes last time.
sasha: I can run a 30m preflight that fires representative prompts into the canary. What are the auto-rollback thresholds here? we should codify.
dan: current auto-rollback rules used by deploy-bot: auto-rollback if P95 latency increases >30% AND error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. Otherwise it will trigger pager and pause rollout. (we can tweak per-rollout)
maya: for this one i'd like a more conservative safety: P95 > 25% OR error-rate > 0.3% for 5m -> auto-rollback. It's a somewhat risky behavior change.
juan: +1 to Maya. Also, add a latency SLO guardrail for streaming chunk latency (per-chunk P95 < 200ms). That caught regressions in earlier runs.
linda: proposal for fallback order: [cerberus-2.0, cerberus-2.0-quant, cerberus-1.8] with a TTL gating on quantized variant to avoid noisy quality flips. quantized_ttl = 30s. If primary is healthy again, quantized is evicted.
maya: i'd rather keep quantized behind legacy for a short TTL. in a few eval cases quantized produced hallucinations. Suggested fallback: [cerberus-2.0, cerberus-1.8, cerberus-2.0-quant] AND quantized_allowed_only_when_primary_over_capacity = true.
juan: downside to that ordering: for some latency-sensitive small responses, quantized was fine and materially cheaper. moving quantized last can spike cost. we need a middle ground: priority weights + TTL.
sasha: operational compromise: use explicit priority weights and TTLs. e.g.
```fallbacks:
  - model: cerberus-2.0
    priority: 100
  - model: cerberus-2.0-quant
    priority: 60
    ttl_seconds: 30
  - model: cerberus-1.8
    priority: 40
```
This means quantized is preferred to legacy when primary is unavailable, but will be evicted after 30s if primary returns. Sounds acceptable?
maya: I can live with that as a default if we also add a quality-monitor check that flags semantic-regression on a curated prompt-set and forces rollback if regression > 2%.
dan: adding quality guard is fine. Make it non-blocking for auto-rollback (alert + pause rollout) unless regression > 5% then auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: noted. Applying rollout config (safe-mode flags):
```rwdctl catalog rollout apply --id rwd-roll-1940 \
  --traffic 10% --region us-west-2 \
  --fallback-order "cerberus-2.0:100,cerberus-2.0-quant:60:ttl30,cerberus-1.8:40" \
  --auto-rollback-p95 25 --auto-rollback-error 0.3 \
  --quality-alert 2 --quality-rollback 5
```
deploy-bot: config apply successful. canary traffic now routed (10%). Monitoring dashboards: https://internal.redwood/ops/dashboards/rwd-roll-1940
sasha: starting preflight load + curated prompt-set run now. i'll paste a quick summary in 20m. @oncall-sre please watch latency and error-rate channels.
maya: pinning command if we need an emergency stop:
```rwdctl catalog pin --model cerberus-2.0 --priority 100 --note "emergency pin during rollout"
```
That will force routing to the pinned model for all traffic in the specified scope.
juan: rollback command (manual):
```rwdctl rollout rollback --id rwd-roll-1940 --reason "regression detected" --target-weight 0
```
Have an oncall ready to execute if alerts look real.
linda: one more nit — add a short TTL for fallback to quantized for long streaming sessions (some sessions keep chunking and that TTL semantics matter). set streaming_chunk_ttl = 10s in config.
maya: ack. happy to proceed with the priority+ttl approach and the tightened auto-rollback thresholds.
sasha: preflight summary: no immediate errors, P95 within +10% of baseline, error-rate 0.05% for 20m. semantic regression checks: 0.6% on curated prompts (below 2%). continuing ramp monitor.
deploy-bot: current status: rollout rwd-roll-1940 at 10% -> healthy. watchers: maya, sasha, dan, juan, linda. Auto-rollback thresholds in effect. Will post if any guard trips. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks all. leave monitors up for the full change window. if something spikes after 02:15 UTC we should be ready to pin or rollback.
juan: noted. i'll stand by for manual rollback if SRE voices it.
deploy-bot: [deploy] Logged actions: config-apply OK, canary-start OK. Last check-in 1940123520."
